title: 4.11 Everyday Verbs
unit_outcome: Say where people and things are at home, describe a short daily routine, ask and answer Do you...? questions, and say the day and the time.
goal: Say what you make, see, use, find and give, and who comes home, with people, pets and things you already know.
grammar_function: I + verb + known object (I make breakfast. I see the bus.); I find my + thing + under the + furniture; They + verb with no -s (They make breakfast.); give + thing + to + person.
prerequisite: 1.10 dog, cat; 1.11 husband, wife, son, daughter, friend, friends; 2.11 big, small, new, used; 4.1 home; 4.2 bed, sofa, computer; 4.3 under; 4.5 breakfast; 4.7 I/we/they + action.
speaking_outcome: Say I make breakfast., I see the bus., I use the computer., I come home. and one sentence with find and give.
